verdict.rationale: Airweave's documented capabilities center on syncing data sources and letting agents *search* that data (via MCP server, CLI, direct/agentic search) — there is no evidence of agent-invoked add, update, or delete operations on memory content mid-conversation. missing for 10: evidence of write/update/delete APIs or tools callable by an agent, evidence of a memory object model distinct from synced source data, any documentation of mutating memory via tool calls.
